violations.description: Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was not stored in a proper location to be protected from contamination. Single use items found stored on the floor in the kitchen area. Single use items should be stored off of the floor.

Demonstration of conformance with variance. — --License holder did not demonstrate conformance with approved variance or HACCP procedures. Temperature log has not been completed since 10/24/26. Temperatures should be recorded daily as states in HACCP plan.

Storage of cleaned equipment and utensils. — --Clean equipment/utensil was not stored in a clean, dry manner to protect from contamination. - Knives stored above sink in the vegetable/fruit cutting room in need of more thorough cleaning. Storage block knives are held in should be cleaned on a more regular basis.
